description: Refine an icon result set or preview known icon refs returned by another Supericons tool. Use search_icons first for normal icon requests. Icon lists up to 100 refs are accepted and safely truncated to 12. Returns ready-to-use Markdown, a hosted preview fallback, a direct PNG image URL, and, when requested, an MCP image contact sheet.

icon_refs.description: Optional fixed icon refs in library:id format. Arrays, a single ref, and comma-separated refs are accepted. Up to 100 are accepted, 24 appear on the browser preview, and 12 are rendered inline. Send at most 100; very large arrays are refused.

include_image.description: When true, include a PNG contact sheet as MCP image content. Boolean strings are accepted. A preview_url is always returned.

library.description: Optional library key. Supported values include si (Supericons AI and developer tool logos), lucide, tabler, phosphor, heroicons, bootstrap, iconoir, ionicons, material, simpleicons (Simple Icons brand logos), and mingcute.

limit.description: Requested inline icon count. Values outside 1 to 12 are safely clamped with a warning. Numeric strings are accepted.

locale.description: Optional locale for multilingual search terms. Supported values: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, es, de, pt, ar, hi, vi, th. Unsupported values are ignored with a warning.

query.description: Optional search query to preview visually, for example "license plate recognition camera scan car".

style.description: Optional style preference. Unsupported values are ignored with a warning.

name: preview_icons

browser_preview_count.description: Number of accepted icon refs available at preview_url.

client_display_note.description: Plain-language note for clients that do not render images inline.

error.description: Recoverable error message when preview inputs are missing or invalid.

image_included.description: Whether this response includes MCP image content.

image_url.description: Direct PNG URL for clients or Markdown renderers that can show remote images.

markdown_image.description: Ready-made Markdown image snippet for final answers in clients that render remote Markdown images.

next_step.description: Useful next action for the caller.

query.description: Search query used for the visual preview, if any.

rendered_count.description: Number of icons rendered in the inline preview.

results.description: Icons included in the visual preview.

icon_preview_url.description: Browser URL for visual inspection of this icon.

icon_ref.description: Stable icon reference in library:id format.

id.description: Icon ID without the library prefix.

library_key.description: Source icon library key repeated for explicit agent display.

library_label.description: Public source library label, for example Supericons (si).

library_name.description: Public source library name, for example Supericons or Simple Icons.

semantic.description: Public semantic guidance for search and agent selection.

style.description: Icon style such as outline or solid.

suggested_response_markdown.description: Ready-to-use answer with the image, refs, and browser fallback link.

truncated_from.description: Original icon ref count when the input was truncated.

warnings.description: Unsupported optional inputs that were safely ignored.

title: Preview Icons
